title: HardObtainment
description: This project adds hard more balanced crafting recipes to Minecraft. So far here is the crafting recipes we have changed: Mace
body:
# Hard Obtainment
### This datapack adds more balanced (harder) crafting recipes for too easy to obtain items for now the supported items are :  **Mace.**

For now the datapack doesn't have functions (Avalability) to toggle these recipes but Developers are working on it.

So it is a hard mace crafting recipe datapack

**Mace :**
